about: Original graded texts for Lessico. Each text glosses its key words in 'words' (form in the text, lower case -> dictionary entry); a word glossed in an earlier text and met again later is shown as one to remember.

okumak: to read; to study (at a school)
kalkmak: to get up; to depart (a vehicle)
yatmak: to go to bed; to lie down
abla: older sister (also a friendly way to address a woman)
amca: uncle (also a friendly way to address an older man)
tatmak: to taste (tattırmak = to let someone taste)
çıkmak: to go out; to leave (yola çıkmak = to set off)
aramak: to call (on the phone); to look for
şekil: shape; way (… bir şekilde = in a … way)
zorunda: obliged to (… zorunda olmak = to have to)
kazanmak: to gain; to earn; to win
çoğu: most (çoğu zaman = most of the time)
kopmak: to break off; to be cut off
ikram etmek: to offer (food or drink to a guest)
kadar: until; as much as (ne kadar = how much)
süre: period of time (kısa sürede = in a short time)
çaydanlık: double teapot (a kettle with a teapot on top)
demek: to say; to be called (denilen = called)
katlı: with floors or tiers (iki katlı = two-tier)
vermek: to give (… -e vermek = to spend on)
doğurmak: to give birth to; to cause
gidip gelmek: to go back and forth; to commute
karşılık: response (buna karşılık = on the other hand)
ilgili: related (… ile ilgili = to do with)
ertesi: the next (ertesi gün = the next day)
söndürmek: to switch off; to put out
hanım: Mrs; lady (polite, after a first name: Ayşe Hanım)
orta: middle (… ortasında = in the middle of)
aidat: building fees (paid each month for a block of flats)
öpmek: to kiss (öpüyorum = love, at the end of a message)
beyaz: white (beyaz peynir = white cheese, like feta)
pide: pide, a flat bread baked with a filling
yan: side (yanında = next to it, with it)
soğumak: to get cold; to cool down
yağmak: to rain; to snow (yağmur yağıyor = it is raining)
dökülmek: to fall (of leaves); to be spilled
baş: head (başı ağrıyor = he has a headache)
sayı: number (çok sayıda = a large number of)
sevgi: love (sevgiler = love, at the end of a letter)
takmak: to put on; to wear (a cap, glasses)
bozulmak: to break down; to be damaged
cezve: cezve, a small long-handled coffee pot
başvurmak: to apply (for a job or opportunity)
haber vermek: to let someone know; to notify
hazırlanmak: to prepare oneself; to get ready
inmek: to get off; to go down
katılmak: to join; to participate; to attend
sessize almak: to mute; to put on silent
uzun uzun: for a long time; at length

texts.title: Ana
texts.before: Have you ever lived in another country? What would you want to learn first?
p: Ana, İspanya'nın Sevilla şehrinden.
Ana is from the city of Seville in Spain.
Yirmi iki yaşında.
She is twenty-two years old.
Şimdi Ankara'da yaşıyor.
Now she lives in Ankara.
İstasyonun yakınında küçük bir dairede oturuyor.
She lives in a small flat near the station.
Her sabah üniversiteye gidiyor.
Every morning she goes to university.
Orada Türkçe öğreniyor.
She learns Turkish there.
Kurs biraz zor ama dersler çok ilginç.
The course is a little difficult, but the lessons are very interesting.
Ana İspanyolca ve İngilizce biliyor.
Ana knows Spanish and English.
Artık biraz da Türkçe konuşuyor.
She can now speak a little Turkish too.

q.en: Ana now lives in Spain.
q.why: Ana is from Spain but now lives in Ankara.

q.en: Where does Ana live now?
q.why: Paragraph 1 says that Ana now lives in Ankara.

q.en: What is Ana learning at university?
q.why: She goes to university to learn Turkish.

q.en: Which languages does Ana know?
q.why: She knows Spanish and English, and she now speaks a little Turkish.

texts.title: Ayşe Hanım
texts.before: What does a patient teacher do when a student does not understand?
p: Ayşe Hanım Ankaralı.
Mrs Ayşe is from Ankara.
Elli yaşında ve üniversitede Türkçe öğretiyor.
She is fifty years old and teaches Turkish at the university.
Öğrencileri başka ülkelerden geliyor.
Her students come from other countries.
Sınıfında on iki öğrenci var.
There are twelve students in her class.
Ana İspanyol, Kim Koreli, Ahmed ise Mısırlı.
Ana is Spanish, Kim is Korean, and Ahmed is Egyptian.
Hepsi Türkçe öğrenmek istiyor.
They all want to learn Turkish.
Ayşe Hanım derste yavaş konuşuyor.
Mrs Ayşe speaks slowly in class.
Yeni kelimeleri tahtaya yazıyor.
She writes new words on the board.
Ana bir kelimeyi anlamıyor.
Ana does not understand one word.
Ayşe Hanım onu tekrar söylüyor.
Mrs Ayşe says it again.
Öğrenciler «Onunla Türkçe öğrenmek çok kolay!» diyor.
The students say, ‘It is very easy to learn Turkish with her!’

q.en: Mrs Ayşe is from Ankara.
q.why: She is described as Ankaralı, meaning from Ankara.

q.q: Ayşe Hanım'ın sınıfında kaç öğrenci var?
q.en: How many students are in Mrs Ayşe’s class?
q.why: There are twelve students in the class.

q.q: Ana bir kelimeyi anlamayınca Ayşe Hanım ne yapıyor?
q.en: What does Mrs Ayşe do when Ana does not understand a word?
q.why: Mrs Ayşe repeats the word.

q.q: «Onunla Türkçe öğrenmek çok kolay!» cümlesinde «onunla» kim?
q.en: In ‘It is very easy to learn Turkish with her!’, who is ‘her’?
q.why: The students are talking about their teacher, Mrs Ayşe.

q.q: Bu metin en çok neyi anlatıyor?
q.en: What is this text mainly about?
q.why: It introduces Mrs Ayşe and shows how she helps her students learn Turkish.

texts.title: Mehmet ve Zeynep
texts.before: Who does what in your family during a normal weekday?
p: Mehmet ve Zeynep Ankara'da yaşıyor.
Mehmet and Zeynep live in Ankara.
Evli ve iki çocukları var: Emre ile Defne.
They are married and have two children, Emre and Defne.
Mehmet kırk yaşında ve doktor.
Mehmet is forty years old and is a doctor.
Bir hastanede çalışıyor.
He works in a hospital.
Zeynep otuz sekiz yaşında.
Zeynep is thirty-eight.
Şehir merkezinde bir kitapçıda çalışıyor.
She works in a bookshop in the city centre.
Orada kitap satıyor.
She sells books there.
Emre on yaşında ve okula gidiyor.
Emre is ten and goes to school.
Defne daha küçük, üç yaşında.
Defne is younger, only three years old.
Anaokuluna gidiyor.
She goes to nursery school.
Akşamları aile evde buluşuyor.
In the evenings, the family gets together at home.
Birlikte yemek yiyor ve sohbet ediyorlar.
They eat together and have a chat.

q.en: Mehmet works in a bookshop.
q.why: Mehmet works in a hospital; Zeynep works in the bookshop.

q.q: Mehmet ve Zeynep'in kaç çocuğu var?
q.en: How many children do Mehmet and Zeynep have?
q.why: They have two children: Emre and Defne.

q.en: Where does Defne go?
q.why: Paragraph 3 says that Defne goes to nursery school.

q.q: «Zeynep bir kitapçıda çalışıyor. Orada kitap satıyor.» Kitapçı ne demek?
q.en: ‘Zeynep works in a kitapçı. She sells books there.’ What does kitapçı mean?
q.why: She sells books there, so kitapçı means a bookshop.

q.en: What is this text about?
q.why: The text introduces the parents, children and everyday family life.

texts.title: Ana'nın sınıfı
texts.before: People have different reasons to learn a language. What are yours?
p: Ana'nın Türkçe sınıfında on iki öğrenci var.
There are twelve students in Ana’s Turkish class.
En genç öğrenci Kim; on dokuz yaşında.
The youngest student is Kim; he is nineteen.
Helen ise altmış beş yaşında.
Helen, on the other hand, is sixty-five.
Sınıfın en yaşlı öğrencisi o.
She is the oldest student in the class.
Helen İngiliz ve emekli.
Helen is English and retired.
Türk tarihini ve müziğini çok seviyor.
She really likes Turkish history and music.
Bu yüzden Türkçe öğreniyor.
That is why she is learning Turkish.
Ahmed Mısırlı; akşamları bir lokantada çalışıyor.
Ahmed is Egyptian; he works in a restaurant in the evenings.
Sara Brezilyalı ve Türkiye'de aşçı olmak istiyor.
Sara is Brazilian and wants to become a cook in Turkey.
Herkesin farklı bir hayali var.
Everyone has a different dream.

q.en: Who is the youngest student in the class?
q.why: Kim is nineteen and is described as the youngest.

q.en: Helen works in a restaurant.
q.why: Helen is retired; Ahmed works at a restaurant.

q.en: Why is Helen learning Turkish?
o: Türk tarihini ve müziğini sevdiği için
q.why: She enjoys Turkish history and music.

q.q: «Helen İngiliz ve emekli.» Emekli ne demek?
q.en: ‘Helen is English and emekli.’ What does emekli mean?
q.why: Helen is sixty-five, and the text says she is emekli, meaning retired.

q.en: What is the main idea of the text?
q.why: It introduces classmates from different backgrounds and explains their motivations.

texts.title: Kafe Bulut
texts.before: If you went to a café with 100 lira, what could you order?
p: Kafe Bulut, Tunalı Hilmi Caddesi No. 12, Ankara.
Café Bulut, 12 Tunalı Hilmi Street, Ankara.
Pazartesi–cumartesi: 08.00–20.00.
Monday–Saturday: 8 a.m.–8 p.m.
Pazar günleri kapalı.
Closed on Sundays.
İçecekler: çay 20 TL, Türk kahvesi 60 TL, latte 90 TL, taze portakal suyu 80 TL.
Drinks: tea 20 TL, Turkish coffee 60 TL, latte 90 TL, fresh orange juice 80 TL.
Yiyecekler: simit 25 TL, tost 110 TL.
Food: simit 25 TL, toasted sandwich 110 TL.
Öğrenci kahvaltısı: çay ve simit birlikte 35 TL.
Student breakfast: tea and simit together for 35 TL.
Bu kahvaltı sadece sabahları var.
This breakfast is available only in the mornings.
Wi-Fi müşteriler için ücretsiz.
Wi-Fi is free for customers.

q.en: How much is a Turkish coffee?
q.why: Turkish coffee costs 60 TL.

q.en: The café is open on Sundays.
q.why: It is closed on Sundays.

q.en: What is included in the student breakfast?
q.why: The student breakfast includes tea and simit.

q.q: «Wi-Fi müşteriler için ücretsiz.» Ücretsiz ne demek?
q.en: ‘Wi-Fi is ücretsiz for customers.’ What does ücretsiz mean?
q.why: The café does not charge customers for Wi-Fi.

q.en: When is the student breakfast available?
q.why: The offer is available only in the mornings.

texts.title: Kütüphane
texts.before: What rules would you expect at a university library?
p: Üniversite kütüphanesi kampüsün ortasında.
The university library is in the middle of the campus.
Hafta içi 09.00'dan 21.00'e kadar açık.
It is open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. on weekdays.
Cumartesi sadece sabah açık.
On Saturday it is open only in the morning.
Pazar günleri kapalı.
It is closed on Sundays.
Kütüphanede kitaplar, gazeteler ve bilgisayarlar var.
There are books, newspapers and computers in the library.
Öğrenciler burada sessizce ders çalışıyor.
Students study quietly here.
Ana da sık sık buraya geliyor.
Ana comes here often too.
Eve kitap götürmek için öğrenci kartı gerekiyor.
You need a student card to take books home.
Kitap ödünç almak ücretsiz.
Borrowing books is free.
Ödünç alma süresi bir ay.
The loan period is one month.
Kütüphanede yemek yemek ve telefonla konuşmak yasak.
Eating and talking on the phone are not allowed in the library.

q.en: The library is open on Sundays.
q.why: Paragraph 1 says it is closed on Sundays.

q.en: What is there in the library?
q.why: The library has books, newspapers and computers.

q.q: Eve kitap götürmek için ne gerekiyor?
q.en: What do you need to take books home?
q.why: A student card is required to borrow books.

q.en: How long is the loan period?
q.why: Books can be borrowed for one month.

q.q: «Kütüphanede telefonla konuşmak yasak.» Yasak ne demek?
q.en: ‘Talking on the phone is yasak in the library.’ What does yasak mean?
q.why: Talking on the phone is prohibited in the library.

texts.title: Kiralık daire
texts.before: What three details matter most when choosing a flat?
p: Bahçelievler'de kiralık daire.
Flat for rent in Bahçelievler.
Metroya yürüyerek on dakika.
Ten minutes’ walk from the metro.
Daire ikinci katta.
The flat is on the second floor.
Binada asansör var.
There is a lift in the building.
Dairede iki yatak odası, bir salon, bir mutfak ve bir banyo var.
The flat has two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom.
Mutfak küçük ama yeni.
The kitchen is small but new.
Balkondan park görünüyor.
You can see the park from the balcony.
Aylık kira 18.000 TL.
The monthly rent is 18,000 TL.
Aidat bu fiyata dahil.
The building fees are included in this price.
Bir aile ya da iki öğrenci için ideal.
Ideal for a family or two students.
Bilgi için akşamları arayın: 0532 123 45 67.
For information, call in the evenings: 0532 123 45 67.

q.en: How many bedrooms does the flat have?
q.why: There are two bedrooms.

q.en: The building fees are not included in the rent.
q.why: The advert says the building fees are included.

q.en: What can you see from the balcony?
q.why: The balcony overlooks the park.

q.en: How do you get to the metro?
q.why: The flat is ten minutes from the metro on foot.

q.q: Daire hakkında bilgi için ne zaman aramak gerekiyor?
q.en: When should you call for information about the flat?
q.why: The advert asks people to call in the evenings.

texts.title: Benim adım Elif
texts.before: How would you tell a new friend about your home, studies and family?
p: Merhaba, ben Elif.
Hello, I’m Elif.
Yirmi iki yaşındayım.
I’m twenty-two years old.
Ankara'da tek başıma yaşıyorum.
I live on my own in Ankara.
Evim küçük ama güzel.
My home is small but nice.
Kedim Pamuk da benimle yaşıyor.
My cat Pamuk lives with me too.
Üniversitede İngilizce öğretmenliği okuyorum.
I study to become an English teacher at university.
Sabah derslerim var, akşamları bir kafede çalışıyorum.
I have classes in the morning and work at a café in the evenings.
Orada çay ve kahve hazırlıyorum.
I prepare tea and coffee there.
Ailem İzmir'de yaşıyor.
My family lives in İzmir.
Bir erkek kardeşim var: Can.
I have a brother called Can.
Can İstanbul'da çalışıyor.
Can works in İstanbul.
Annemle her pazar telefonda konuşuyorum.
I speak to my mum on the phone every Sunday.
Can'ı da sık sık arıyorum.
I call Can often too.

q.en: Elif lives in İzmir.
q.why: Elif lives in Ankara. Her family lives in İzmir.

q.q: Elif'in Pamuk adında bir kedisi var.
q.en: Elif has a cat called Pamuk.
q.why: She says her cat Pamuk lives with her.

q.en: Where does Elif work in the evenings?
q.why: She works at a café in the evenings.

q.en: Where does Elif’s brother work?
q.why: Her brother Can works in İstanbul.

q.en: What does Elif talk about in this text?
q.why: Elif introduces her home, studies, part-time work and family.

texts.title: Elif'in bir günü
texts.before: What does your normal day look like from morning to night?
p: Elif sabah yedide kalkıyor.
Elif gets up at seven in the morning.
Önce duş alıyor.
First she has a shower.
Sonra kahvaltı yapıyor: peynir, zeytin, ekmek ve çay.
Then she has breakfast: cheese, olives, bread and tea.
Sekiz buçukta otobüse biniyor.
She gets on the bus at half past eight.
Üniversiteye yirmi dakikada gidiyor.
She gets to university in twenty minutes.
Derslerden sonra arkadaşlarıyla öğle yemeği yiyor.
After class she has lunch with her friends.
Akşam altıda kafede çalışmaya başlıyor.
At six in the evening she starts work at the café.
Dört saat sonra eve dönüyor.
Four hours later she goes home.
Pamuk kapıda onu bekliyor.
Pamuk waits for her at the door.
Elif biraz kitap okuyor, sonra yatıyor.
Elif reads for a while, then goes to bed.

q.en: Elif gets up at eight in the morning.
q.why: She gets up at seven, not eight.

q.en: Elif goes to university by bus.
q.why: She takes the bus at half past eight and arrives at university twenty minutes later.

q.en: How many hours does Elif work at the café?
q.why: She starts at six and leaves four hours later.

q.en: ‘Pamuk waits for her at the door.’ Who does ‘her’ refer to?
q.why: Pamuk is the cat waiting for Elif.

q.en: What is the main idea of the text?
q.why: It follows Elif through her usual day, from breakfast to bedtime.

texts.title: Yılmaz ailesi
texts.before: Think of a busy family. Who lives together and what do they enjoy?
p: Yılmaz ailesi Ankara'da yaşıyor.
The Yılmaz family lives in Ankara.
Murat taksi şoförü, eşi Gül hemşire.
Murat is a taxi driver, and his wife Gül is a nurse.
Üç çocukları var: Burak, Selin ve Ali.
They have three children: Burak, Selin and Ali.
Burak on sekiz yaşında ve lisede son sınıfta.
Burak is eighteen and in his last year of secondary school.
Selin on beş yaşında, keman çalıyor.
Selin is fifteen and plays the violin.
Ali altı yaşında.
Ali is six years old.
Dinozorları çok seviyor.
He really loves dinosaurs.
Murat'ın babası İsmail Dede de onlarla yaşıyor.
Grandpa İsmail, Murat’s father, lives with them too.
Akşamları bütün aile birlikte yemek yiyor.
In the evenings, the whole family eats together.
Evde bazen gürültü oluyor ama herkes çok neşeli.
The house can get noisy sometimes, but everyone is cheerful.

q.en: What does Gül do for work?
q.why: Gül is a nurse.

q.en: Ali is the oldest child in the family.
q.why: Ali is six; Burak is eighteen and Selin is fifteen.

q.en: Which musical instrument does Selin play?
q.why: Selin plays the violin.

q.q: «İsmail Dede de onlarla yaşıyor.» «Onlarla» kimleri anlatıyor?
q.en: ‘Grandpa İsmail lives with them too.’ Who does ‘them’ refer to?
q.why: Grandpa İsmail lives with the Yılmaz family.

q.q: «Evde bazen gürültü oluyor ama herkes çok neşeli.» Neşeli ne demek?
q.en: ‘The house is sometimes noisy, but everyone is neşeli.’ What does neşeli mean?
q.why: Even when the house is noisy, everyone is happy and cheerful.

texts.title: Babaanne
texts.before: Does someone in your family grow vegetables or cook a special dish?
p: Elif'in babaannesi Fatma Hanım, İzmir'e yakın bir köyde yaşıyor.
Elif's grandmother, Fatma Hanım, lives in a village near İzmir.
Seksen bir yaşında.
She is eighty-one years old.
Evi eski ama çok güzel.
Her house is old but very beautiful.
Büyük bir bahçesi var.
She has a big garden.
Bahçede çiçekler, meyve ağaçları ve bir bostan var.
Her garden has flowers, fruit trees and a vegetable patch.
Bostan, sebze yetiştirilen küçük bir bahçe demek.
A bostan is a small garden where vegetables are grown.
Fatma Hanım burada domates, biber ve fasulye yetiştiriyor.
Fatma Hanım grows tomatoes, peppers and beans here.
Her sabah bostanda çalışıyor.
She works in the vegetable garden every morning.
Öğleden sonra gazete okuyor veya televizyon izliyor.
In the afternoon she reads the newspaper or watches television.
Pazar günleri bütün aile onun evine geliyor.
The whole family comes to her home on Sundays.
Fatma Hanım el açması börek yapıyor.
Fatma Hanım makes börek with hand-rolled pastry.
Hep birlikte öğle yemeği yiyorlar.
They all have lunch together.

q.q: Fatma Hanım İzmir şehir merkezinde yaşıyor.
q.en: Fatma Hanım lives in central İzmir.
q.why: She lives in a village near İzmir.

q.q: «Bostan, sebze yetiştirilen küçük bir bahçe demek.» Bostan nedir?
q.en: What does bostan mean?
q.why: The next words explain that a bostan is a small garden for growing vegetables.

q.en: What does Fatma Hanım grow in the vegetable garden?
q.why: She grows tomatoes, peppers and beans.

q.q: Pazar günleri Fatma Hanım'a kim geliyor?
q.en: Who visits Fatma Hanım on Sundays?
q.why: The whole family visits her on Sundays.

q.en: What is this text mainly about?
q.why: The text describes Grandma Fatma, her garden and Sunday family meals.

texts.title: Can'dan bir mesaj
texts.before: How do you invite your brother or sister to a family birthday meal?
p: Selam abla!
Hi sis!
Nasılsın?
How are you?
Pazar günü babamın doğum günü.
It's Dad's birthday on Sunday.
Annem öğle yemeği hazırlıyor.
Mum is preparing lunch.
Sen de gelebilir misin?
Can you come too?
Saat birde annemlerde buluşuyoruz.
We're meeting at Mum and Dad's at one o'clock.
Ben pastayı getiriyorum.
I'm bringing the cake.
Sen babama bir hediye alabilir misin?
Can you buy Dad a present?
Bir yemek kitabı istiyor.
He wants a cookbook.
Lütfen bana çabuk cevap ver.
Please reply to me soon.
Öpüyorum, Can
Love, Can

q.en: Why is Can sending a message?
q.why: It's their father's birthday on Sunday.

q.en: What time is the meal?
q.why: They are meeting at one o’clock.

q.en: What is Can bringing?
q.why: Can says he is bringing the cake.

q.en: The meal is at Elif’s home.
q.why: It is at their parents’ home, expressed informally as annemlerde.

q.en: Who wants a cookbook?
q.why: The preceding sentence asks Elif to buy their father a gift; he wants a cookbook.

texts.title: Alışveriş listesi
texts.before: What are three things you need to buy when you go to a supermarket?
p: Ana bugün markete gidiyor.
Ana is going to the supermarket today.
Evde süt ve ekmek yok.
There is no milk or bread at home.
Listesinde altı yumurta, bir kilo elma, makarna, domates ve beyaz peynir de var.
Her list also has six eggs, a kilo of apples, pasta, tomatoes and white cheese.
Market Ana'nın evine yakın.
The supermarket is near Ana’s home.
Akşam dokuza kadar açık.
It is open until nine in the evening.
Ana bütün ürünleri alıyor ve kartla ödüyor.
Ana buys everything on her list and pays by card.
Toplam dört yüz yirmi lira harcıyor.
She spends four hundred and twenty lira in total.
Süt ve ekmek kahvaltı için.
The milk and bread are for breakfast.
Makarna ve domates ise akşam yemeği için.
The pasta and tomatoes are for dinner.
Ana alışverişten sonra eve dönüyor.
Ana goes home after shopping.

q.en: How many eggs does Ana buy?
q.why: Her shopping list includes six eggs.

q.en: The supermarket is very far from Ana’s home.
q.why: The market is near her home.

q.en: How does Ana pay?
q.why: She pays by card.

q.en: How many lira does Ana spend in total?
q.why: The amount is four hundred and twenty lira.

q.q: Makarna ve domates hangi yemek için?
q.en: Which meal are the pasta and tomatoes for?
q.why: The pasta and tomatoes are for dinner.

texts.title: Karadeniz Pide Salonu
texts.before: Do you prefer eating at a restaurant or ordering food to your home?
p: Karadeniz Pide Salonu 1985'ten beri açık.
The Black Sea Pide House has been open since 1985.
Salı günleri kapalı, diğer günler açık.
It is closed on Tuesdays and open on the other days.

Pide with kaşar cheese: 220 TL.

Pide with minced meat: 260 TL.

Ayran: 40 TL.

q.why: The Wednesday student offer is 250 TL.

q.why: The text says there is a ten per cent discount on delivery orders.

texts.title: Türk kahvaltısı
texts.before: What do you eat for breakfast on a busy morning and on a relaxed Sunday?
p: Türkiye'de kahvaltı birçok insan için önemli.
Breakfast is important to many people in Turkey.
Kahvaltı günün ilk öğünü, yani ilk yemeği.
Breakfast is the first meal of the day.
«Kahvaltı» kelimesi «kahve altı» sözünden geliyor.
The word kahvaltı comes from the expression kahve altı.
Bu söz, kahveden önce yenen yemek demek.
That expression means a meal eaten before coffee.
Bir Türk kahvaltısında beyaz peynir, zeytin, domates, salatalık ve yumurta olabilir.
A Turkish breakfast may include white cheese, olives, tomatoes, cucumber and eggs.
Kahvaltıda bal, tereyağı, taze ekmek ve simit de oluyor.
Breakfast can also include honey, butter, fresh bread and simit.
Kahvaltıda genellikle çay içiyorlar.
People usually drink tea at breakfast.
Hafta içi insanlar bazen hızlı kahvaltı yapıyor.
On weekdays, people sometimes have a quick breakfast.
Pazar sabahları ise aileler birlikte oturuyor.
On Sunday mornings, families sit together.
Uzun uzun kahvaltı yapıyor ve sohbet ediyorlar.
They spend a long time over breakfast and chat.

q.q: «Kahvaltı günün ilk öğünü, yani ilk yemeği.» Öğün ne demek?
q.en: What does öğün mean?
q.why: The word yani introduces a simple explanation: the day’s first meal.

q.en: Which expression does the word kahvaltı come from?
q.why: The text gives kahve altı as the source expression.

q.en: People eat only eggs at a Turkish breakfast.
q.why: The text lists several foods, including cheese, olives, tomatoes and bread.

q.en: What is usually drunk at breakfast?
q.why: Tea is usually drunk with breakfast.

q.en: What is the text mainly about?
q.why: The text describes the foods and habits associated with breakfast in Turkey.

texts.title: Hava durumu
texts.before: Would you take an umbrella tomorrow? What weather would make you do that?
p: Yarın Karadeniz Bölgesi'nde hava bulutlu.
Tomorrow it will be cloudy in the Black Sea region.
Trabzon ve Rize'de öğleden sonra yağmur var.
There will be rain in Trabzon and Rize in the afternoon.
Ankara'da ise rüzgâr var ama yağmur yok.
In Ankara it will be windy, but there will be no rain.
İzmir ve Antalya'da hava güneşli ve sıcak.
The weather will be sunny and hot in İzmir and Antalya.
Sıcaklık otuz iki dereceye kadar çıkıyor.
The temperature reaches up to thirty-two degrees.
Doğu Anadolu'da hava serin.
The weather is cool in Eastern Anatolia.
Gece birçok yerde hava biraz soğuyor.
At night it gets a little cooler in many places.

q.en: Where will there be rain tomorrow?
q.why: Rain is forecast for Trabzon and Rize in the afternoon.

q.en: There will be rain in Ankara tomorrow.
q.why: The text says Ankara will have wind but no rain.

q.en: What will the weather be like in İzmir and Antalya?
q.why: Both cities are forecast to be sunny and hot.

q.q: «Sıcaklık otuz iki dereceye kadar çıkıyor.» Sıcaklık nedir?
q.en: What does sıcaklık mean?
q.why: It is measured in degrees, so sıcaklık means temperature.

q.en: How does the weather change at night?
q.why: It becomes a little cooler in many places at night.

texts.title: Mevsimler
texts.before: Which season do you like most, and what do you enjoy doing then?
p: Türkiye'de dört mevsim var.
There are four seasons in Turkey.
İlkbahar mart ayında başlıyor.
Spring starts in March.
Günler uzuyor, ağaçlar çiçek açıyor.
The days grow longer and trees blossom.
Yaz haziranda başlıyor.
Summer starts in June.
Hava çok sıcak oluyor.
The weather gets very hot.
Birçok aile tatilde denize gidiyor.
Many families go to the seaside on holiday.
Sonbaharda sık sık yağmur yağıyor.
It often rains in autumn.
Ekim ve kasım aylarında ağaçların yaprakları dökülüyor.
Leaves fall from the trees in October and November.
Kışın hava soğuk, özellikle doğuda.
In winter it is cold, especially in the east.
Dağlarda kar var.
There is snow in the mountains.

q.en: In which month does spring start?
q.why: Spring starts in March.

q.en: Where do many families go in summer?
q.why: Many families go to the seaside on holiday.

q.en: The weather is usually very cold in summer.
q.why: The text says summer weather is very hot.

q.en: What does yaprak mean?
q.why: The leaves belong to trees and fall in autumn.

q.en: What is this text mainly about?
q.why: It describes the weather and typical activities in each of the four seasons.

texts.title: Otobüs saatleri
texts.before: When you take a long-distance bus, do you first check the price or the departure time?
p: Ankara Otogarı: cumartesi günü otobüs saatleri.
Ankara Bus Station: Saturday bus times.

İzmir: departure 09:00, arrival 17:00, ticket 700 TL.

Antalya: departure 10:00, arrival 18:00, ticket 650 TL.

İstanbul: departure 11:00, arrival 17:00, ticket 600 TL.

Cappadocia: departure 12:00, arrival 16:00, ticket 400 TL.
Bütün otobüslerde çay ve su ücretsiz.
Tea and water are free on all buses.
Biletleri otogardan, internetten veya telefonla alabilirsiniz.
You can buy tickets at the bus station, online or by phone.

q.en: Which bus journey is the shortest?
q.why: The Cappadocia trip takes four hours, from noon to 16:00.

q.en: At what time does the İstanbul bus arrive?
q.why: The İstanbul service arrives at 17:00.

q.en: Which ticket is the most expensive?
q.why: The İzmir ticket costs 700 TL, the most of the four.

q.q: Otobüste çay için para ödemek gerekiyor.
q.en: You have to pay for tea on the bus.
q.why: Tea and water are free on all buses.

q.en: What does varış mean?
q.why: It appears after departure and shows when the bus reaches its destination.

texts.title: Yıldız Sineması
texts.before: Which do you prefer at the cinema: comedies, adventure films or family films?
p: Yıldız Sineması, Kızılay: bu haftanın filmleri.
Yıldız Cinema, Kızılay: this week’s films.
Salon 1: «Gizli Bahçe», aile filmi, 16.00 ve 18.30.
Screen 1: The Secret Garden, a family film, at 16:00 and 18:30.

Screen 2: A Night in Rome, a romantic comedy, at 20:30 and 22:45.

Screen 3: The Last Journey, an adventure film, at 21:00.
Bu film orijinal dilinde ve Türkçe altyazılı.
This film is in its original language with Turkish subtitles.
Yani konuşmaların Türkçe çevirisi ekranda görünüyor.
In other words, a Turkish translation of the dialogue appears on the screen.
Tam bilet 200 TL, öğrenci bileti 140 TL.
A full-price ticket is 200 TL and a student ticket is 140 TL.
Çarşamba günleri bütün biletler 100 TL.
All tickets cost 100 TL on Wednesdays.

q.en: Which film is for families?
q.why: Gizli Bahçe is described as a family film.

q.q: Cumartesi günü öğrenci bileti kaç lira?
q.en: How much is a student ticket on Saturday?
q.why: The usual student ticket costs 140 TL. The 100 TL offer is on Wednesday.

q.en: When does The Last Journey start?
q.why: Its screening is listed at 21:00.

q.en: What does altyazı mean?
o: words translated and written on the screen
the people acting in a film
q.why: The following sentence explains that the Turkish words for the dialogue appear on the screen.

q.en: All tickets cost 100 TL on Wednesday.
q.why: The final sentence states that all tickets cost 100 TL on Wednesdays.

texts.title: Ana ve voleybol
texts.before: Can a sports team help you learn a language and meet new people?
p: Ana voleybolu çok seviyor.
Ana loves volleyball.
Ankara'da üniversitenin voleybol takımında oynuyor.
She plays on the university volleyball team in Ankara.
Takımda altı farklı ülkeden on iki öğrenci var.
There are twelve students from six different countries on the team.
Salı ve perşembe akşamları antrenman yapıyorlar.
They train on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.
Antrenman saat yedide başlıyor, dokuzda bitiyor.
Training starts at seven and finishes at nine.
Spor salonu istasyona yakın.
The sports hall is near the station.
Cumartesi günleri başka bir takımla maç yapıyorlar.
On Saturdays they play a match against another team.
Ana burada yeni arkadaşlar ediniyor.
Ana makes new friends here.
Arkadaşlarıyla Türkçe konuşuyor.
She speaks Turkish with her friends.
Bu yüzden voleybol onun için çok önemli.
That is why volleyball is very important to her.

q.en: Which sport does Ana play?
q.why: Ana plays volleyball at university.

q.en: All the students on the team are from the same country.
q.why: There are students from six different countries.

q.en: On which evenings does the team train?
q.why: The training evenings are Tuesday and Thursday.

q.en: What does the team do on Saturdays?
q.why: They play a match against another team on Saturdays.

q.en: Why is volleyball important to Ana?
o: Hem spor yapıyor hem de arkadaş ediniyor ve Türkçe konuşuyor
q.why: Volleyball lets her play sport, make friends and practise Turkish.

texts.title: Mehmet ve Zeynep'in hafta sonu
texts.before: What does your family like to do on a Saturday or Sunday?
p: Mehmet ve Zeynep cumartesi günleri çalışmıyor.
Mehmet and Zeynep do not work on Saturdays.
Sabah semt pazarında alışveriş yapıyorlar.
In the morning they shop at the neighbourhood market.
Öğleden sonra çocukları parka götürüyorlar.
In the afternoon they take the children to the park.
Emre arkadaşlarıyla futbol oynuyor.
Emre plays football with his friends.
Defne ise salıncağa biniyor.
Defne, meanwhile, goes on the swing.
İleri geri sallanmayı çok seviyor.
She loves swinging backwards and forwards.
Cumartesi akşamları bazen arkadaşlarının evine yemeğe gidiyorlar.
On Saturday evenings they sometimes go to their friends' house for dinner.
Bazen de evde film izliyorlar.
Sometimes they watch a film at home instead.
Pazar sabahı geç kalkıyorlar.
They get up late on Sunday mornings.
Hava güzelse Eymir Gölü çevresinde bisiklete biniyorlar.
If the weather is nice, they go cycling around Lake Eymir.

q.en: What do they do on Saturday morning?
q.why: They shop at the neighbourhood market in the morning.

q.en: Emre plays football with his father at the park.
q.why: Emre plays football with his friends.

q.q: «Defne ise salıncağa biniyor. İleri geri sallanmayı çok seviyor.» Salıncak nedir?
q.en: What does salıncak mean?
q.why: Defne sits on it and moves backwards and forwards, which describes a swing.

q.q: Hava güzelse pazar günü nereye gidiyorlar?
q.en: Where do they go on Sunday if the weather is nice?
q.why: They go cycling around Lake Eymir.

q.en: What is this text mainly about?
q.why: The passage describes the family's activities on Saturdays and Sundays.

texts.title: İş ilanları
texts.before: What do you look at first when you read a job advertisement?
p: Şehir merkezindeki restoranımıza garson arıyoruz.
We are looking for a waiter for our restaurant in the city centre.
Çalışma günleri: perşembe, cuma, cumartesi ve pazar.
Working days: Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
Çalışma: akşamları.
Work: evenings.
Deneyim ve iyi İngilizce gerekli.
Experience and good English are required.
Bir kitapçı yarı zamanlı satış elemanı arıyor.
A bookshop is looking for a part-time sales assistant.
Çalışma saatleri: pazartesi, çarşamba ve cuma, 15.00–19.00.
Working hours: Monday, Wednesday and Friday, 3–7 p.m.
Kitapları seven öğrenciler için güzel bir iş.
A nice job for students who love books.
Bir aile, dört ve yedi yaşındaki çocukları için bakıcı arıyor.
A family is looking for a babysitter for their children, aged four and seven.
Çalışma günleri: haftada üç gün, öğleden sonra.
Working days: three afternoons a week.
Saatlik ücret 250 TL.
The hourly pay is 250 TL.
Başvurmak için 0533 555 12 34 numarasını arayın.
To apply, call 0533 555 12 34.

q.q: Hangi iş kitapları seven öğrenciler için?
q.en: Which job is for students who like books?
q.why: The bookshop ad is aimed at students who love books.

q.q: Bakıcı işinde saatlik ücret ne kadar?
q.en: What is the hourly pay for the babysitting job?
q.why: The advertisement says the hourly pay is 250 TL.

q.en: The restaurant job is in the morning.
q.why: The restaurant job has evening hours.

q.en: What is required for the restaurant job?
q.why: The restaurant requires experience and good English.

q.en: What does the text contain?
q.why: All three paragraphs are advertisements for different jobs.

texts.title: Zeynep'in işi
texts.before: Have you ever visited a bookshop? What do the people working there do?
p: Zeynep sekiz yıldır Kızılay'daki bir kitapçıda çalışıyor.
Zeynep has worked in a bookshop in Kızılay for eight years.
Sabah dokuz buçukta işe başlıyor.
She starts work at half past nine in the morning.
Akşam yedide işten çıkıyor.
She leaves work at seven in the evening.
Öğle yemeği için bir saat molası var.
She has an hour's break for lunch.
Genellikle iş arkadaşıyla tost yiyor.
She usually has a toasted sandwich with a colleague.
Zeynep müşterilere yardım ediyor ve onlar için kitap buluyor.
Zeynep helps customers and finds books for them.
Yeni kitaplar sipariş ediyor.
She orders new books.
Kitapları raflara koyuyor.
She puts books on the shelves.
Bazen raflarda yeni kitaplara yer kalmıyor.
Sometimes there is no room for new books on the shelves.
Perşembe öğleden sonra ise çocuklara masal okuyor.
On Thursday afternoons, she reads stories to children.
En çok çocuklara masal okumayı seviyor.
Her favourite part of the job is reading stories to children.

q.en: How long is Zeynep's lunch break?
q.why: She has one hour for lunch.

q.en: Zeynep has worked in the bookshop for two years.
q.why: She has worked there for eight years.

q.q: «Kitapları raflara koyuyor. Bazen raflarda yeni kitaplara yer kalmıyor.» Raf nedir?
q.en: What does raf mean?
q.why: Books are placed on raflar, so raf means shelf.

q.q: Zeynep perşembe öğleden sonra ne yapıyor?
q.en: What does Zeynep do on Thursday afternoons?
q.why: She reads stories to children on Thursday afternoons.

q.en: Who does 'onlar' refer to here?
q.why: The previous words say that Zeynep helps customers; she finds books for them.

texts.title: Hastanede bir gece
texts.before: Who helps people at a hospital during the night?
p: Mehmet bir devlet hastanesinde doktor.
Mehmet is a doctor at a state hospital.
Acil serviste çalışıyor.
He works in the emergency department.
Acil servis hiç kapanmıyor; gece gündüz açık.
The emergency department never closes; it is open day and night.
Mehmet bu hafta gece çalışıyor.
Mehmet is working nights this week.
Saat akşam sekizde işe başlıyor, sabah sekizde bitiriyor.
He starts work at eight in the evening and finishes at eight in the morning.
Geceleri de acil servise hastalar geliyor.
Patients come to the emergency department at night too.
Kolu kırık bir genç geliyor.
A young man with a broken arm arrives.
Bir kadının ateşi çok yüksek.
A woman has a very high fever.
Bir adamın da başı çok ağrıyor.
Another man has a very bad headache.
Mehmet bazen çok yoruluyor.
Mehmet sometimes gets very tired.
Ama insanlara yardım etmeyi seviyor.
But he likes helping people.
Sabah eve dönüyor ve öğlene kadar uyuyor.
In the morning he goes home and sleeps until noon.

q.q: «Acil servis hiç kapanmıyor; gece gündüz açık.» Acil servis nasıl bir yer?
q.en: What is an acil servis?
q.why: The department is part of the hospital and stays open day and night for patients.

q.q: Mehmet bu hafta ne zaman çalışıyor?
q.en: When does Mehmet work this week?
q.why: His shift runs from 8 p.m. to 8 a.m.

q.en: The emergency department closes at night.
q.why: It never closes and stays open day and night.

q.en: Which patient has a high fever?
q.why: The woman has a very high fever.

q.q: Mehmet sabah eve dönünce ne yapıyor?
q.en: What does Mehmet do after returning home in the morning?
q.why: He sleeps until noon.

texts.title: Ankara
texts.before: What places would you show someone visiting your city for the first time?
p: Ankara, Türkiye'nin başkenti.
Ankara is the capital of Turkey.
Hükümet ve meclis Ankara'da çalışıyor.
The government and parliament work in Ankara.
Ankara 1923 yılında başkent oldu.
Ankara became the capital in 1923.
Burada beş milyondan fazla insan yaşıyor.
More than five million people live here.
İstanbul'dan sonra Türkiye'nin en kalabalık ikinci şehri.
It is Turkey's second most populous city after Istanbul.
Ankara'da çok sayıda üniversite var.
There are many universities in Ankara.
Bu yüzden şehirde çok öğrenci yaşıyor.
That is why many students live in the city.
Anıtkabir de burada; Atatürk'ün mezarı Anıtkabir'de.
Anıtkabir is here too; Atatürk's tomb is in Anıtkabir.
Kızılay, şehrin en hareketli yerlerinden biri.
Kızılay is one of the busiest parts of the city.
Burada kafeler, dükkânlar ve kalabalık caddeler var.
There are cafés, shops and busy streets here.

q.en: In what year did Ankara become the capital?
q.why: The text explicitly says Ankara became the capital in 1923.

q.q: «Ankara, Türkiye'nin başkenti. Hükümet ve meclis Ankara'da çalışıyor.» Başkent ne demek?
q.en: What does başkent mean?
q.why: Ankara is the capital, and the government and parliament are based there.

q.en: Ankara is Turkey's most populous city.
q.why: Ankara is second after Istanbul.

q.en: Where is Atatürk's tomb?
q.why: The passage says Atatürk's tomb is in Anıtkabir.

q.en: What is the passage about?
q.why: It introduces Ankara's capital status, population and places of interest.

texts.title: Üniversiteye nasıl gidiyorlar?
texts.title_en: How do they get to university?
texts.before: How do you usually travel to school or work?
p: Ankara'da öğrenciler üniversiteye farklı yollarla gidiyor.
In Ankara, students travel to university in different ways.
Birçoğu metroya biniyor, çünkü metro hızlı ve ucuz.
Many take the metro because it is fast and cheap.
Metro trafikte beklemiyor.
The metro does not get stuck in traffic.
Bazı öğrenciler otobüse biniyor.
Some students take the bus.
Yağmurlu günlerde otobüs rahat, ama sabahları genellikle çok dolu.
The bus is convenient on rainy days, but usually very crowded in the mornings.
Kampüse yakın oturan öğrenciler yürüyerek gidiyor.
Students who live near the campus go on foot.
Çok az öğrenci araba kullanıyor.
Very few students drive.
Çünkü otopark bulmak zor ve benzin pahalı.
That is because parking is hard to find and petrol is expensive.
Ana istasyonun yakınında oturuyor.
Ana lives near the station.
O da üniversiteye metroyla gidiyor.
She also goes to university by metro.

q.en: Why do many students take the metro?
q.why: The metro is fast, cheap and avoids traffic.

q.en: Buses are usually empty in the morning.
q.why: The passage says buses are usually very full in the morning.

q.q: Neden çok az öğrenci araba kullanıyor?
q.en: Why do very few students drive?
o: Otopark bulmak zor ve benzin pahalı olduğu için
q.why: Parking is hard to find and petrol is expensive.

q.en: How does Ana travel to university?
q.why: Ana goes to university by metro.

q.en: What does the passage compare?
q.why: It compares metro, bus, walking and driving as ways to get to university.

texts.title: Antalya'dan bir kartpostal
texts.before: What would you tell a friend in a postcard from a holiday?
p: Sevgili Elif,
Dear Elif,
Üniversiteden iki arkadaşımla üç günlüğüne Antalya'ya geldim.
I came to Antalya for three days with two friends from university.
Burası büyük, kalabalık ama çok güzel bir şehir!
It is a big, busy but very beautiful city!
Dün Kaleiçi'ni gezdik.
Yesterday we walked around Kaleiçi.
Kaleiçi, Antalya'nın eski şehir merkezi.
Kaleiçi is the old town centre of Antalya.
Sonra müzeye gittik.
Then we went to the museum.
Bugün otobüsle Aspendos'a gidiyoruz.
Today we are going to Aspendos by bus.
Bence dünyanın en tatlı portakalları burada!
I think the sweetest oranges in the world are here!
Hava sıcak ve her gün güneşli.
It is hot and sunny every day.
Pazar akşamı Ankara'ya dönüyorum.
I am going back to Ankara on Sunday evening.
Sevgiler, Ana
Love, Ana

q.en: Who is Ana with in Antalya?
q.why: She has come with two friends from university.

q.q: «Kaleiçi, Antalya'nın eski şehir merkezi.» Kaleiçi nedir?
q.en: What is Kaleiçi?
q.why: The next sentence explains that Kaleiçi is the old town centre.

q.en: It rains every day in Antalya.
q.why: Ana says it is hot and sunny every day.

q.en: When is Ana returning to Ankara?
q.why: She says she is going back on Sunday evening.

q.q: «Burası büyük, kalabalık ama çok güzel bir şehir!» Burası neresi?
q.en: Which place does burası refer to?
q.why: Ana has just said that she is in Antalya.

texts.title: Mehmet ve Zeynep'in evi
texts.before: How many rooms are there in your home? Where do you spend the most time?
p: Mehmet ve Zeynep şehrin dışında, küçük bahçeli bir evde oturuyor.
Mehmet and Zeynep live outside the city in a house with a small garden.
Evleri iki katlı.
Their house has two floors.
Giriş katında mutfak, salon ve bir banyo var.
On the ground floor there is a kitchen, a living room and a bathroom.
Mutfak büyük ve aydınlık.
The kitchen is big and bright.
Mutfakta altı kişilik bir masa var.
There is a table for six in the kitchen.
Birinci katta üç yatak odası ve bir banyo daha var.
Upstairs there are three bedrooms and another bathroom.
Emre'nin odasında çok kitap ve futbolcu posterleri var.
Emre has lots of books and footballer posters in his room.
Defne hâlâ annesiyle babasının odasında uyuyor.
Defne still sleeps in her parents' room.
Ama yakında kendi odası olacak.
But she will soon have her own room.

q.en: Which floor is the kitchen on?
q.why: The kitchen is on the ground floor.

q.en: How many bedrooms are there?
q.why: There are three bedrooms upstairs.

q.en: Defne now sleeps in her own room.
q.why: She still sleeps in her parents' room.

q.q: «Mutfak büyük ve aydınlık.» Aydınlık ne demek?
q.en: What does aydınlık mean?
q.why: Aydınlık means bright, describing the kitchen as a light-filled room.

q.en: What is in Emre's room?
q.why: His room has lots of books and posters of football players.

texts.title: Ev arkadaşı aranıyor
texts.before: What would you want to know before moving into a shared flat?
p: Merhaba!
Hello!
Cebeci'deki evimize bir kız ev arkadaşı arıyoruz.
We are looking for a female flatmate for our home in Cebeci.
Biz üç üniversite öğrencisiyiz.
We are three university students.
Ben Selin, 22 yaşındayım.
I'm Selin and I'm 22 years old.
Diğer arkadaşlarım 21 ve 24 yaşında.
My other housemates are 21 and 24.
Boş oda tek kişilik.
The available room is for one person.
Büyük bir penceresi ve dolabı var.
It has a big window and a wardrobe.
Banyo ve mutfak ortak; hepimiz kullanıyoruz.
The bathroom and kitchen are shared; we all use them.
Kira ayda 7.000 TL, faturalar hariç.
The rent is 7,000 TL per month, not including bills.
Sakin, düzenli ve sigara içmeyen bir arkadaş arıyoruz.
We are looking for a quiet, tidy flatmate who does not smoke.
Evcil hayvan kabul etmiyoruz.
We do not allow pets.
Bana mesaj gönderin.
Send me a message.
My number is 0544 222 88 99.

q.en: What is the room's monthly rent?
q.why: The monthly rent is 7,000 TL excluding bills.

q.q: «Banyo ve mutfak ortak; hepimiz kullanıyoruz.» Ortak ne demek?
q.en: What does ortak mean?
q.why: Everyone uses the bathroom and kitchen, so they are shared.

q.en: Pets are allowed in the flat.
q.why: The advert states that they do not allow pets.

q.en: What sort of flatmate are they looking for?
q.why: They want a quiet, tidy non-smoker.

q.en: How many students currently live in the home?
q.why: Three university students live there now.

texts.title: Selin'e bir e-posta
texts.before: What information should you include when writing about a room for rent?
p: Merhaba Selin,
Hi Selin,
Ben Sara.
I'm Sara.
Brezilyalıyım ve üniversitede Türkçe öğreniyorum.
I'm Brazilian and I'm learning Turkish at university.
Ev arkadaşı ilanınızı gördüm.
I saw your flatmate advertisement.
Odanızla ilgileniyorum.
I'm interested in your room.
Ben sakin ve düzenli biriyim.
I'm a quiet and tidy person.
Sigara içmiyorum.
I don't smoke.
Akşamları bir lokantada çalışıyorum, bu yüzden eve geç dönüyorum.
I work in a restaurant in the evenings, so I come home late.
Ama evde gürültü yapmıyorum.
But I don't make noise at home.
Yemek yapmayı seviyorum.
I enjoy cooking.
Size bir Brezilya yemeği de yapabilirim!
I could even make you a Brazilian dish!
Odayı cumartesi sabahı görebilir miyim?
Could I see the room on Saturday morning?
Teşekkürler, görüşmek üzere!
Thanks, speak soon!
Sara
Sara

q.en: Why is Sara writing to Selin?
q.why: Sara saw the flatmate advertisement and is interested in the room.

q.en: Sara smokes.
q.why: Sara explicitly says she does not smoke.

q.en: Why does Sara get home late?
q.why: She works in a restaurant in the evenings.

q.q: «Size bir Brezilya yemeği de yapabilirim!» Burada «size» kim?
q.en: Who does 'size' refer to in this sentence?
q.why: Sara is addressing Selin and her housemates in her email.

q.q: Sara odayı ne zaman görmek istiyor?
q.en: When does Sara want to see the room?
q.why: She asks to see it on Saturday morning.

texts.title: Doktorda
texts.before: When you are ill, what do you usually tell the doctor?
p: – Günaydın, doktor hanım.
– Good morning, doctor.
– Günaydın, Ahmed. Neyiniz var?
– Good morning, Ahmed. What seems to be the problem?
– Boğazım iki gündür ağrıyor. Biraz da ateşim var.
– My throat has hurt for two days. I also have a slight fever.
Çok yorgunum.
I am very tired.
– Bir bakalım. Grip olmuşsunuz ama ciddi değil.
– Let me have a look. You have the flu, but it is not serious.
Üç dört gün evde kalın ve bol su için.
Stay at home for three or four days and drink plenty of water.
Bu ilacı ateşiniz için günde iki kez, yemekten sonra alın.
Take this medicine for your fever twice a day, after meals.
– Peki, işe gidebilir miyim? Bir lokantada garson olarak çalışıyorum.
– Well, can I go to work? I work as a waiter in a restaurant.
– Hayır, bu hafta işe gitmeyin. Evde dinlenin!
– No, do not go to work this week. Rest at home!

q.en: What is wrong with Ahmed?
q.why: Ahmed says his throat hurts and he has a fever.

q.en: Ahmed has been ill for three days.
q.why: He says his throat has hurt for two days, not three.

q.en: When does the doctor tell him to take the medicine?
q.why: The doctor says twice daily, after meals.

q.en: Where does Ahmed work?
q.why: Ahmed says he works as a waiter in a restaurant.

q.en: What is this conversation about?
q.why: Ahmed tells the doctor his symptoms and receives advice about medicine and rest.

texts.title: Yüzme havuzunun kuralları
texts.before: What rules do people have to follow at a swimming pool?
p: Belediyenin yüzme havuzuna hoş geldiniz!
Welcome to the municipal swimming pool!
Herkesin rahatça yüzmesi için lütfen kurallara uyun.
Please follow the rules so that everyone can swim comfortably.
Havuza girmeden önce duş alın.
Take a shower before entering the pool.
Havuzda bone, yani yüzme şapkası, takmak zorunlu.
You must wear a swimming cap, called a bone, in the pool.
Havuzun kenarında koşmayın. Yerler ıslak, düşebilirsiniz.
Do not run around the edge of the pool. The floor is wet and you could fall.
Havuzun yanında yemek yemek ve bir şey içmek yasak.
Eating and drinking beside the pool are not allowed.
On iki yaşından küçük çocuklar havuza sadece bir yetişkinle girebilir.
Children under twelve may enter the pool only with an adult.
Anlayışınız için teşekkürler!
Thank you for your understanding!

q.en: What must you do before entering the pool?
q.why: The notice says to take a shower before entering.

q.q: «Bone, yani yüzme şapkası» sözünde bone ne demek?
q.en: What does 'bone' mean in this sentence?
q.why: The words after 'yani' explain that bone is a swimming cap.

q.en: Running beside the pool is allowed.
q.why: The rules say not to run because the floor is wet.

q.q: On yaşındaki bir çocuk havuza kiminle girebilir?
q.en: With whom may a ten-year-old enter the pool?
q.why: Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult.

q.en: What is the purpose of this text?
q.why: It lists the rules visitors must follow at the swimming pool.

texts.title: Genç bir mimar: Deniz
texts.before: What would you put in a house that is good for the environment?
p: Deniz otuz iki yaşında. İzmir’de mimar olarak çalışıyor.
Deniz is thirty-two. She works as an architect in İzmir.
Küçük bir ofiste iki kişiyle birlikte çalışıyor.
She works with two people in a small office.
Ev ve okul tasarlıyor.
She designs houses and schools.
Deniz için çevre, yani doğa, çok önemli.
The environment, that is, nature, is very important to Deniz.
Binalarında tahta, güneş panelleri ve bol bitki kullanıyor.
She uses wood, solar panels and lots of plants in her buildings.
Deniz işini çok seviyor. Bazen cumartesi günleri de çalışıyor.
Deniz loves her job. She sometimes works on Saturdays too.
Boş zamanlarında yoga yapıyor ve resim çiziyor.
In her free time she does yoga and draws.
En büyük hayali bir dağ köyünde okul yapmak.
Her biggest dream is to build a school in a mountain village.

q.en: Where does Deniz work?
q.why: She works as an architect in a small office in İzmir.

q.q: «Çevre, yani doğa» sözünde çevre ne anlama geliyor?
q.en: What does 'çevre' mean here?
q.why: 'Yani' directly explains 'çevre' as nature.

q.en: Deniz never works on Saturdays.
q.why: She sometimes works on Saturdays.

q.en: What does Deniz do in her free time?
q.why: She does yoga and draws.

q.en: What is Deniz’s biggest dream?
q.why: She dreams of building a school in a mountain village.

texts.title: Aziz Sancar
texts.before: Have you heard of a scientist who won a Nobel Prize?
p: Aziz Sancar 1946'da Mardin'in Savur ilçesinde doğdu.
Aziz Sancar was born in 1946 in Savur, a district of Mardin.
Sekiz çocuklu bir ailede büyüdü. Ailenin yedinci çocuğuydu.
He grew up in a family with eight children. He was the seventh child.
İstanbul Üniversitesi'nde tıp okudu ve bir süre doktor olarak çalıştı.
He studied medicine at İstanbul University and worked as a doctor for a while.
Sonra Amerika'ya gitti ve DNA üzerine araştırma yaptı.
Then he went to America and carried out research on DNA.
DNA bazen bozuluyor. Hücreler onu onarıyor. Sancar bunu araştırdı.
DNA sometimes gets damaged. Cells repair it. Sancar studied this.
2015'te Nobel Kimya Ödülü'nü kazandı.
He won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 2015.
Bilim alanında Nobel kazanan ilk Türk oldu.
He became the first Turkish person to win a Nobel Prize in a scientific field.

q.en: Where was Aziz Sancar born?
q.why: He was born in Savur, Mardin.

q.en: Aziz Sancar was the first child in his family.
q.why: He was the seventh of eight children.

q.en: What did he study at university?
q.why: He studied medicine.

q.en: What does 'onu' refer to in 'Cells repair it'?
q.why: The previous sentence says that DNA sometimes gets damaged.

q.q: Nobel Kimya Ödülü'nü hangi yıl kazandı?
q.en: In which year did he win the Nobel Prize in Chemistry?
q.why: The passage gives 2015 as the year of the Nobel Prize.

texts.title: Türk kahvesi
texts.before: How is coffee prepared where you live?
p: Türk kahvesi için çok ince çekilmiş kahve kullanıyoruz.
For Turkish coffee, we use very finely ground coffee.
Kahveyi ve suyu cezveye koyuyoruz.
We put the coffee and water in a cezve.
Cezve, yani uzun saplı küçük bir kap.
A cezve is a small pot with a long handle.
İsteyen biraz şeker de ekliyor. Sonra kahveyi yavaş yavaş pişiriyoruz.
Anyone who wants can add a little sugar. Then we cook the coffee slowly.
Türk kahvesi küçük bir fincanda geliyor. Üstünde köpük oluyor.
Turkish coffee comes in a small cup. It has foam on top.
Yanında genellikle bir bardak su ve bir lokum var.
It usually comes with a glass of water and a piece of Turkish delight.
Kahveyi içince fincanın dibinde telve kalıyor.
After you drink the coffee, grounds remain at the bottom of the cup.
Bazı insanlar telveye bakıp fal bakıyor.
Some people look at the coffee grounds and tell fortunes.
Türk kahvesi kültürü 2013'te UNESCO listesine girdi.
Turkish coffee culture was added to the UNESCO list in 2013.

q.q: «Cezve, yani uzun saplı küçük bir kap.» Cezve nedir?
q.en: What is a 'cezve'?
q.why: 'Yani' introduces the explanation: a small pot with a long handle.

q.en: What usually comes with Turkish coffee?
q.why: The text mentions water and Turkish delight.

q.q: Türk kahvesinin üstünde hiç köpük yok.
q.en: Turkish coffee never has foam on top.
q.why: The passage says there is foam on top.

q.en: What stays at the bottom of the coffee cup?
q.why: Coffee grounds, or telve, remain at the bottom.

q.q: Türk kahvesi kültürü UNESCO listesine ne zaman girdi?
q.en: When was Turkish coffee culture added to the UNESCO list?
q.why: The third paragraph gives 2013.

texts.title: Ana'nın günlüğü
texts.before: What is one thing you would write about in a diary today?
p: 14 Ekim, pazartesi.
Monday, 14 October.
Bugün uzun bir gündü.
Today was a long day.
Sabah saat yedide kalktım ve üniversiteye metroyla gittim.
I got up at seven in the morning and went to university by metro.
Saat dokuzda Ayşe Hanım'la Türkçe dersimiz vardı.
At nine we had a Turkish lesson with Mrs Ayşe.
Bugün geçmiş zamanı öğrendik!
Today we learned the past tense!
Öğlen Kim ve Sara'yla tost yedim.
At lunchtime I ate a toasted sandwich with Kim and Sara.
Öğleden sonra kütüphaneye gittim ve iki kitap ödünç aldım.
In the afternoon I went to the library and borrowed two books.
Akşam Sevilla'daki annemi aradım.
In the evening I called my mum in Seville.
Şimdi çok yorgunum. Hemen yatıyorum.
Now I am very tired. I am going straight to bed.

q.en: How did Ana get to university?
q.why: She says she went by metro.

q.en: What did they learn in their Turkish class?
q.why: They learned the past tense.

q.en: Ana ate lunch alone.
q.why: She had lunch with Kim and Sara.

q.en: How many books did Ana borrow from the library?
q.why: She borrowed two books.

q.en: Who is speaking in 'Now I am very tired'?
q.why: Ana writes the diary in the first person.

texts.title: Doğum günü daveti
texts.before: What do you tell friends when you invite them to a birthday party?
p: Sizi doğum günü partime bekliyorum!
I look forward to seeing you at my birthday party!
Yirmi yaşına giriyorum. Hepiniz davetlisiniz!
I am turning twenty. You are all invited!
Birlikte güzel bir akşam geçireceğiz!
We will have a lovely evening together!
Ne zaman: 25 Ekim cuma, saat 20.00.
When: Friday, 25 October, at 8 p.m.
Nerede: Kim'in evi, Tunalı Hilmi Caddesi 10, üçüncü kat.
Where: Kim's home, 10 Tunalı Hilmi Street, third floor.
Pizza, tatlılar ve Kore müziği var!
There will be pizza, desserts and Korean music!
Yiyecekleri ben hazırlıyorum. Siz sadece içecek getirin.
I am preparing the food. Just bring drinks.
Lütfen çarşambaya kadar haber verin.
Please let me know by Wednesday.
Telefon: 0551 444 77 88. Sevgiler, Kim.
Phone: 0551 444 77 88. Love, Kim.

q.en: How old is Kim turning?
q.why: Kim says he is turning twenty.

q.en: When is the party?
q.why: The invitation says Friday at 8 p.m.

q.en: The party is on the second floor.
q.why: The invitation says third floor.

q.en: What should guests bring?
q.why: Kim is preparing the food and asks guests to bring drinks.

q.q: Kim ne zamana kadar cevap istiyor?
q.en: By when does Kim want an answer?
q.why: Guests should reply by Wednesday.

texts.title: Elif'in geçen hafta sonu
texts.before: What did you do last weekend?
p: Geçen cuma akşamı Elif, Kim'in doğum günü partisine gitti.
Last Friday evening Elif went to Kim’s birthday party.
Arkadaşlarıyla pizza yedi ve gece yarısına kadar dans etti.
She ate pizza with her friends and danced until midnight.
Cumartesi Elif kafede çalışmadı.
On Saturday Elif did not work at the café.
Sabah mahalle pazarından meyve ve peynir aldı.
In the morning she bought fruit and cheese at the neighbourhood market.
Öğleden sonra Ana ve diğer arkadaşlarıyla parkta buluştu.
In the afternoon she met Ana and her other friends in the park.
Birlikte voleybol oynadılar. Ana çok iyi oynadı!
They played volleyball together. Ana played very well!
Pazar günü Elif geç kalktı. Sonra kardeşi Can'ı aradı.
On Sunday Elif got up late. Then she called her brother Can.

q.q: Elif cuma akşamı bir doğum günü partisine gitti.
q.en: Elif went to a birthday party on Friday evening.
q.why: The first paragraph says she attended Kim’s party on Friday evening.

q.en: What did Elif buy on Saturday morning?
q.why: She bought fruit and cheese at the market.

q.en: What did Elif play in the park?
q.why: She played volleyball with Ana and friends.

q.q: «Ana çok iyi oynadı!» Ana ne oynadı?
q.en: What did Ana play in 'Ana played very well'?
q.why: The previous sentence says that they played volleyball.

q.en: Whom did Elif call on Sunday?
q.why: She called her brother Can.

texts.title: «Konuşalım!» Dil Okulu
texts.before: What information matters most when choosing a language course?
p: Türkçe öğrenmek ister misiniz?
Would you like to learn Turkish?
O zaman «Konuşalım!» Dil Okulu’na gelin!
Then come to the «Konuşalım!» Language School!
Adres: Atatürk Bulvarı 22.
Address: 22 Atatürk Boulevard.
Her seviyede Türkçe kursumuz var.
We have Turkish courses at every level.
Yoğun kurs: pazartesiden cumaya, her gün dört saat. Aylık 9.000 TL.
Intensive course: Monday to Friday, four hours every day. 9,000 TL a month.
Akşam kursu: haftada iki akşam. Aylık 4.000 TL.
Evening course: two evenings a week. 4,000 TL a month.
Sınıflarımız küçük. Bir sınıfta en fazla on öğrenci var.
Our classes are small. There are at most ten students in a class.
Cuma öğleden sonraları şehir gezileri ve sinema etkinlikleri var.
On Friday afternoons there are city tours and cinema activities.
Birlikte Türk yemekleri de yapıyoruz. İlk ders ücretsiz!
We also cook Turkish food together. The first lesson is free!

q.q: Yoğun kursta haftanın hangi günleri ders var?
q.en: On which days does the intensive course have lessons?
q.why: The intensive course runs Monday through Friday.

q.en: How much does the evening course cost per month?
q.why: The evening course costs 4,000 TL per month.

q.q: Bir sınıfta en fazla yirmi öğrenci var.
q.en: There are at most twenty students in a class.
q.why: The maximum class size is ten, not twenty.

q.q: Cuma öğleden sonra hangi etkinlikler var?
q.en: What activities are offered on Friday afternoons?
q.why: The school offers city tours and cinema activities.

q.en: What is this advertisement about?
q.why: It advertises Turkish courses, prices, class sizes and activities.

texts.title: Öğrenciler okula nasıl geliyor?
texts.title_en: How do the students come to school?
texts.before: How do students in your area usually get to school?
p: Ankara'daki bir lisede 600 öğrenci bir ankete katıldı.
At a secondary school in Ankara, 600 students took part in a survey.
Hepsi aynı soruya cevap verdi: «Sabah okula nasıl geliyorsun?»
They all answered the same question: «How do you get to school in the morning?»
Sonuçlar şöyle:
Here are the results:
Öğrencilerin yüzde otuz beşi otobüsle, yüzde otuzu yürüyerek geliyor.
Thirty-five per cent of students come by bus and thirty per cent walk.
Yüzde yirmisi metroya biniyor.
Twenty per cent take the metro.
Sadece yüzde on beşi ailesiyle arabayla geliyor.
Only fifteen per cent come by car with their family.
Bazı öğrenciler otobüsü seviyor, çünkü arkadaşlarıyla birlikte geliyorlar.
Some students like taking the bus because they travel with their friends.
Okul müdürü, yani okulun başındaki kişi, sonuçlardan memnun.
The school head, that is, the person in charge of the school, is pleased with the results.
Okulun önünde daha az araba var. Bu, daha az trafik ve daha temiz hava demek.
There are fewer cars in front of the school. That means less traffic and cleaner air.

q.q: «Okul müdürü, yani okulun başındaki kişi» sözünde müdür kimdir?
q.en: Who is a 'müdür' in this sentence?
q.why: 'Yani' explains that the müdür is the person in charge of the school.

q.q: En çok öğrenci okula nasıl geliyor?
q.en: How do the largest number of students get to school?
q.why: The largest group is the 35% who come by bus.

q.en: What percentage of students walk to school?
q.why: Thirty per cent walk.

q.en: Twenty per cent of students come by car.
q.why: Twenty per cent take the metro; only fifteen per cent come by car.

q.en: Why is the head teacher pleased?
o: Daha az trafik ve daha temiz hava var
q.why: Fewer cars near the school mean less traffic and cleaner air.

texts.title: Cumartesi pazarı
texts.before: Where do you buy fruit and vegetables? How is a street market different from a supermarket?
p: Cumartesi günleri Elif'in dersi yok, bu yüzden geç kalkıyor.
On Saturdays Elif has no classes, so she gets up late.
Kahvaltıdan sonra mahallenin pazarına gidiyor.
After breakfast she goes to the neighbourhood market.
Pazar evine çok yakın, bu yüzden yürüyerek gidiyor.
The market is very close to her home, so she walks there.
Pazarda her şey var: meyve, sebze, peynir, zeytin, hatta giysiler.
There is everything at the market: fruit, vegetables, cheese, olives, even clothes.
Satıcılar yüksek sesle bağırıyor: «Domatesler taze, abla! Gel, bak!»
The sellers shout loudly: 'The tomatoes are fresh, sister! Come and look!'
Elif mevsim meyvelerini seviyor: kışın portakal, yazın karpuz ve şeftali alıyor.
Elif loves fruit in season: in winter she buys oranges, in summer watermelon and peaches.
Pazarda fiyatlar marketten daha ucuz ve sebzeler daha taze.
At the market prices are lower than at the supermarket and the vegetables are fresher.
Elif, yıllardır peynir satan Hasan Amca'yı iyi tanıyor.
Elif knows Uncle Hasan, who has been selling cheese for years, well.
Her hafta havadan, futboldan ve aileden konuşuyorlar.
Every week they talk about the weather, football and family.
Hasan Amca ona her zaman yeni bir peynir tattırıyor.
Uncle Hasan always lets her taste a new cheese.
Eve dönünce Elif aldıklarıyla öğle yemeği hazırlıyor.
When she gets home, Elif makes lunch with what she bought.
Onun için pazar sadece alışveriş yapılan bir yer değil; mahallenin bir parçası olmanın bir yolu.
For her the market is not just a place to shop; it's a way of being part of the neighbourhood.

q.en: Elif gets up early on Saturdays.
q.why: She has no classes on Saturdays, so she gets up late.

q.en: Elif goes to the market by bus.
q.why: The market is close to her home, so she walks (yürüyerek).

q.en: Uncle Hasan has two children.
q.why: The text says nothing about Uncle Hasan's children.

q.q: Elif neden pazardan alışveriş yapmayı seviyor?
q.en: Why does Elif like shopping at the market?
o: Fiyatlar daha ucuz ve sebzeler daha taze
q.why: Prices are lower and the vegetables are fresher than at the supermarket.

q.q: Paragraf 3: «Hasan Amca ona her zaman yeni bir peynir tattırıyor». «Ona» kim?
q.en: Paragraph 3: 'Uncle Hasan always lets her taste a new cheese'. Who is 'her' (ona)?
q.why: Uncle Hasan gives Elif a new cheese to taste.

q.q: Paragraf 3: «yeni bir peynir tattırıyor». «Tattırmak» büyük ihtimalle ne demek?
q.en: What does 'tattırmak' probably mean?
q.why: It comes from 'tatmak' (to taste): he lets her try a new cheese.

q.en: What is the main idea?
o: Pazar, Elif'in hayatında önemli bir yer
q.why: The last paragraph sums it up: the market is a way of being part of the neighbourhood.

texts.title: İstanbul'a otobüs yolculuğu
texts.before: Think about your last long journey by bus or train. What happened before you left, on the way and when you arrived?
p: Geçen hafta sonu Elif, kardeşi Can'ın doğum günü için İstanbul'a gitti.
Last weekend Elif went to İstanbul for her brother Can's birthday.
Biletini iki gün önce internetten aldı, çünkü hafta sonları otobüsler genellikle dolu oluyor.
She bought her ticket online two days before, because buses are usually full at weekends.
Otobüs gece on birde kalkıyordu, ama Elif terminale yarım saat erken gitti.
The bus was leaving at eleven at night, but Elif went to the terminal half an hour early.
Bir bardak çay içti ve peronda bekledi.
She drank a glass of tea and waited on the platform.
Maalesef otobüs yirmi dakika rötarla yola çıktı.
Unfortunately the bus set off twenty minutes late.
Yolculuk yaklaşık altı saat sürüyor.
The journey takes about six hours.
Elif önce kitabını okudu, sonra pencereden dışarıya baktı ama hava karanlıktı.
Elif first read her book, then looked out of the window, but it was dark.
Sabaha karşı Boğaz'ın ışıklarını gördü.
Towards morning she saw the lights of the Bosphorus.
Can onu terminalde büyük bir gülümsemeyle bekliyordu.
Can was waiting for her at the terminal with a big smile.
Bütün gün birlikte gezdiler, akşam da annelerini aradılar.
They went around together all day, and in the evening they called their mother.
Pazar akşamı Elif yorgun ama mutlu bir şekilde Ankara'ya döndü.
On Sunday evening Elif went back to Ankara, tired but happy.

q.en: Elif bought her ticket at the terminal.
q.why: She bought it online two days before.

q.en: The bus left late.
q.why: It set off twenty minutes late (yirmi dakika rötarla).

q.en: Elif slept on the bus.
q.why: We know she read and looked out of the window; the text doesn't say whether she slept.

q.q: Ankara'dan İstanbul'a yolculuk ne kadar sürüyor?
q.en: How long does the journey from Ankara to İstanbul take?
q.why: The journey takes about six hours.

q.en: Paragraph 4: 'Can was waiting for her at the terminal'. Who is 'her' (onu)?
q.why: Can was waiting for his sister Elif.

q.q: Paragraf 2: «otobüs yirmi dakika rötarla yola çıktı». «Rötar» ne demek?
q.en: What does 'rötar' mean?
q.why: The bus left twenty minutes after its time: a delay.

q.en: What is the text about?
o: Bir aile kutlaması için otobüs yolculuğu
q.why: Elif takes the bus to İstanbul for her brother's birthday.

texts.title: Can’ın atkısı
texts.before: Have you ever forgotten something at a relative’s house?
p: Pazartesi sabahı Can, İstanbul gezisinden sonra Elif’e bir mesaj gönderdi.
On Monday morning Can sent Elif a message after her visit to Istanbul.
Doğum günü çok güzel geçmiş, ama Can küçük bir sorun fark etmiş.
The birthday had apparently gone very well, but Can had noticed a small problem.
Elif evde atkısını unutmuş; atkı, yani soğuk havada boyuna takılan sıcak bir giysi.
Elif had left her scarf at the house; a scarf is a warm item of clothing worn around the neck in cold weather.
Can atkıyı salonda, koltuğun arkasında buldu.
Can found the scarf in the living room, behind the sofa.
«İstersen sana haftaya getiririm», diye yazdı.
‘If you like, I’ll bring it to you next week,’ he wrote.
Ama Elif’in atkıya hemen ihtiyacı vardı, çünkü Ankara’da hava çok soğuktu.
But Elif needed the scarf straight away because the weather in Ankara was very cold.
Can önce ne yapacağını bilmiyordu; sonra paketin en kolay çözüm olacağını düşündü.
At first Can did not know what to do; then he thought that a parcel would be the easiest solution.
Can ertesi gün bir paket hazırladı ve Elif’ten adresini istedi.
The next day Can prepared a parcel and asked Elif for her address.
İşe giderken paketi gönderdi, sonra kardeşini telefonla aradı.
He sent the parcel on his way to work, then called his sister.
Elif ona teşekkür etti ve hafta sonu tekrar konuşacaklarını söyledi.
Elif thanked him and said they would speak again at the weekend.
«Bir dahaki yolculukta çantamı daha iyi kontrol edeceğim», dedi.
‘On my next journey I’ll check my bag more carefully,’ she said.

q.en: Can found the scarf on the bus.
q.why: He found it behind the sofa in his living room.

q.en: Why does Elif want her scarf straight away?
q.why: It is very cold in Ankara.

q.en: What does ‘atkı’ mean in paragraph one?
q.why: The text describes an item of warm clothing worn around the neck.

q.en: In paragraph two, who does ‘sana’ refer to?
q.why: Can writes to Elif and says he can bring it to her.

q.en: Can posted the parcel on his way to work.
q.why: He sent it on his way to work.

q.q: Can paketi hazırlamadan önce Elif’ten ne istedi?
q.en: What did Can ask Elif for before sending the parcel?
q.why: He asked for her address.

q.en: What is the main subject of the text?
q.why: Can finds Elif’s forgotten scarf and sends it to her.

texts.title: Elif’in İstanbul günlüğü
texts.before: What do you enjoy showing a visitor in your city?
p: Cumartesi günü Can’la İstanbul’da buluştuk ve birlikte uzun bir yürüyüş yaptık.
On Saturday I met Can in Istanbul and we went for a long walk together.
Sabah hava serindi, fakat yağmur yağmıyordu.
The weather was cool in the morning, but it was not raining.
Önce sahile indik, sonra küçük bir kafede kahvaltı yaptık.
First we went down to the waterfront, then had breakfast at a small café.
Can simit ve peynir aldı, ben ise sıcak çay içtim.
Can had simit and cheese, while I drank hot tea.
Kafenin fiyatları beklediğimden daha ucuzdu ve deniz manzarası çok güzeldi.
The café’s prices were lower than I expected and the sea view was beautiful.
Orada bir süre otururken kardeşim bana işini anlattı.
While we were sitting there for a while, my brother told me about his job.
Öğleden sonra yağmur başladı, ama yanımızda şemsiye yoktu.
It started raining in the afternoon, but we had no umbrella.
Islanmamak için yakındaki bir müzeye girdik ve eski fotoğraflara baktık.
To avoid getting wet, we went into a nearby museum and looked at old photographs.
Müze düşündüğümden daha ilginçmiş; çok şey öğrendim.
It turned out the museum was more interesting than I had expected; I learned a lot.
Akşam otobüs terminaline giderken biraz acele ettik.
We hurried a little on our way to the bus terminal in the evening.
Yol boyunca geçen hafta yaptığımız güzel şeylerden tekrar konuştuk.
On the way we talked again about the nice things we had done last week.
Can bana «Yine gel!» dedi, ben de gelecek ay döneceğime söz verdim.
Can said ‘Come again!’ and I promised I would return next month.

q.en: It was raining in the morning.
q.why: It was cool but not raining in the morning.

q.q: Elif ve Can kahvaltıdan önce nereye gittiler?
q.en: Where did Elif and Can go before breakfast?
q.why: They walked down to the waterfront first.

q.en: What place does ‘orada’ in paragraph two refer to?
q.why: They were sitting in the café as Can told Elif about work.

q.en: Elif found the museum boring.
q.why: She found it more interesting than expected.

q.en: Why did they enter the museum?
q.why: They entered when it began raining and they had no umbrella.

q.q: Elif ne zaman tekrar gelmeye söz verdi?
q.en: When did Elif promise to return?
q.why: She promised to return next month.

q.en: What does the text mainly describe?
q.why: It is Elif’s diary of a day with her brother in Istanbul.

texts.title: Kafe Bulut’ta özel gün
texts.title_en: A special day at Café Bulut
texts.before: Would you join a workshop to learn how to make coffee?
p: Elif’in çalıştığı Kafe Bulut, bu cumartesi öğrenciler ve aileler için özel bir program hazırlayacak.
Café Bulut, where Elif works, will prepare a special programme for students and families this Saturday.
Sabah dokuzdan on bire kadar bir atölye, yani birlikte öğrenmek için yapılan kısa bir ders olacak.
From nine to eleven there will be a workshop, a short class in which people learn together.
Atölyeye en fazla on iki kişi katılabilecek ve cuma gününe kadar rezervasyon gerekiyor.
No more than twelve people can attend the workshop, and bookings are required by Friday.
Atölyenin fiyatı kişi başına 150 TL; bu fiyata bir kahve ve küçük bir pasta dahil.
The workshop costs 150 TL per person; this includes a coffee and a small cake.
Katılmak istemeyenler normal kahvaltı yapabilecek.
Those who do not want to participate can have a normal breakfast.
Çay ve simit 60 TL, tost ve ayran ise 140 TL olacak.
Tea and simit will cost 60 TL, while a toasted sandwich and ayran will cost 140 TL.
Öğleden sonra Sara, Brezilya tatlılarıyla ilgili bir tadım yapacak.
In the afternoon Sara will hold a tasting of Brazilian sweets.
Bu etkinlik ücretsiz, ancak içecekler ayrıca ödenecek.
The event is free, but drinks are paid for separately.
Elif ve Ana sabah erkenden gelip masaları hazırlayacak.
Elif and Ana will come early in the morning to prepare the tables.
Yağmur yağarsa bütün etkinlikler kafenin içinde yapılacak.
If it rains, all the activities will take place inside the café.

q.en: What does ‘atölye’ mean in paragraph one?
q.why: The text explains it as a short lesson where people learn together.

q.q: Atölyeye en fazla kaç kişi katılabilecek?
q.en: What is the maximum number of workshop participants?
q.why: The maximum is twelve people.

q.en: No reservation is needed to attend the workshop.
q.why: A reservation must be made by Friday.

q.q: Çay ve simit kaç TL olacak?
q.en: How much will tea and simit cost?
q.why: The tea and simit combination costs 60 TL.

q.en: What does ‘Bu etkinlik’ in paragraph three refer to?
q.why: It refers to Sara’s afternoon tasting.

q.en: Sara’s event will be free.
q.why: There is no event fee, though drinks cost extra.

q.en: What is the purpose of this text?
q.why: It announces activities, prices and booking conditions.

texts.title: Atölye sabahı
texts.before: How would you react if someone spilled a drink during a class?
p: Cumartesi sabahı Elif normalden daha erken kalktı, çünkü kafede kahve atölyesi vardı.
On Saturday morning Elif got up earlier than usual because there was a coffee workshop at the café.
Oraya geldiğinde Ana çoktan masaları hazırlıyordu.
When she arrived there, Ana was already preparing the tables.
Sara da evde yaptığı küçük pastayı getirmişti.
Sara had also brought a small cake she had made at home.
Saat dokuzda on iki kişi geldi; Kim ve Ahmed de onların arasındaydı.
Twelve people arrived at nine; Kim and Ahmed were among them.
Elif önce onlara kahve yapmayı gösterdi, sonra herkes kendi kahvesini hazırladı.
First Elif showed them how to make coffee; then everyone made their own.
Kim hızlı çalıştı, ama Ahmed’in kahvesi daha güzel görünüyordu.
Kim worked quickly, but Ahmed’s coffee looked nicer.
Bir müşteri yanlışlıkla masaya süt döktü ve çok utandı.
A customer accidentally spilt milk on the table and felt very embarrassed.
Elif ona temiz bir önlük verdi, sonra masayı birlikte sildiler.
Elif gave the customer a clean apron, then they wiped the table together.
Kimse kızmadı; herkes küçük bir kaza olabileceğini biliyordu.
Nobody got angry; everyone knew a small accident could happen.
Etkinlik bitince Sara pastayı misafirlere ikram etti.
When the event finished, Sara offered the guests the cake.
Elif çok yorulmuştu, fakat gelecek ay başka bir atölye yapmaya karar verdi.
Elif was very tired, but decided to hold another workshop next month.

q.en: Elif arrived at the café after Ana.
q.why: Ana was already preparing the tables when Elif arrived.

q.en: Who made the cake?
q.why: Sara brought the cake she had made at home.

q.en: Who does ‘onlara’ in paragraph two refer to?
q.why: Elif first demonstrated coffee-making to the workshop participants.

q.en: Who worked faster?
q.why: Kim worked quickly, but Ahmed’s coffee looked nicer.

q.en: The customer spilled tea on the table.
q.why: It was milk, not tea.

q.en: What will Elif do next month?
q.why: She decided to organise another workshop next month.

q.en: What event is described in the text?
o: Kafede bir atölye ve küçük bir kaza
q.why: The text follows the workshop, a minor spill and Elif’s decision afterwards.

texts.title: Okulun çiftlik gezisi
texts.before: What should a school trip notice tell parents?
p: Emre’nin okulu, Ankara yakınlarındaki bir çiftliğe gezi düzenleyecek.
Emre’s school will organise a trip to a farm near Ankara.
Zeynep programı oğluyla birlikte okudu, çünkü Emre bu geziyi uzun zamandır bekliyordu.
Zeynep read the programme with her son because Emre had been waiting for the trip for a long time.
Buluşma noktası, yani herkesin bir araya geleceği yer, sabah sekizde okulun önü.
The meeting point, the place where everyone will gather, is in front of the school at eight in the morning.
Minibüs sekiz buçukta kalkacak ve çocuklar saat dokuzda çiftliğe varacak.
The minibus will leave at half past eight, and the children will reach the farm at nine.
Önce bir rehber onlara hayvanları gösterecek; sonra bahçedeki sebzeleri inceleyecekler.
First a guide will show them the animals; then they will examine the vegetables in the garden.
Öğle yemeğini herkes evinden getirecek.
Everyone will bring lunch from home.
Gezi ücreti çocuk başına 200 TL ve minibüs bu fiyata dahil.
The trip costs 200 TL per child, and the minibus is included in that price.
Veliler ayrıca su ve yiyecek hazırlayacak, fakat başka para ödemeyecek.
Parents will also prepare water and food, but will not pay anything else.
Çocuklar öğleden sonra saat dörtte okula dönecek.
The children will return to school at four in the afternoon.
Zeynep bu bilgileri telefonuna yazdı ve Emre’ye sabah geç kalmamasını söyledi.
Zeynep wrote this information on her phone and told Emre not to be late in the morning.
Yağmur yağarsa dışarıda gezmek yerine içeride ekmek yapmayı öğrenecekler.
If it rains, instead of walking outside, they will learn to make bread indoors.

q.en: What does ‘buluşma noktası’ mean?
q.why: It is defined as the place where everyone gathers.

q.en: At what time will the minibus leave?
q.why: The programme specifies 8.30.

q.en: Lunch is included in the trip fee.
q.why: Children must bring lunch from home.

q.en: Who does ‘onlara’ in paragraph two refer to?
q.why: The guide will show the animals to the children.

q.en: What will the children do if it rains?
q.why: The alternative indoor activity is bread-making.

q.en: The minibus is included in the fee.
q.why: The fee includes transport.

q.en: What is the purpose of the text?
o: Geziyle ilgili saat, ücret ve kuralları anlatmak
q.why: The notice gives parents practical trip details.

texts.title: Emre’nin günlüğü
texts.before: How do you feel when rain changes your plans?
p: Bugün okulla çiftliğe gittik ve çok eğlendim.
Today we went to the farm with school and I had a lot of fun.
Sabah erkenden uyandım, çünkü minibüsü kaçırmak istemiyordum.
I woke up early because I did not want to miss the minibus.
Annem Zeynep bana peynirli ekmek, elma ve bir şişe su hazırlamıştı.
My mum Zeynep had prepared a cheese sandwich, an apple and a bottle of water for me.
Çiftliğe varınca hava güneşliydi ve bütün hayvanlar dışarıdaydı.
